question: How well do common Taiwan retail proxies represent directly identified domestic-individual market participation at aggregate frequency, before any return/outcome analysis?

directBaseline.source: TWSE Fact Book annual trading value by shareholder structure
directBaseline.semantics: directly identified domestic-individual share of market trading value
directBaseline.firstKnownGuard: historical annual publication can support finalized aggregate replay but not exact historical intrayear firstKnownAt unless separately preserved

proxy1_marginPurchase.interpretation: aggregate margin-purchase activity co-moves materially with direct retail participation over this six-year window, but does not identify the full retail universe and diverges in some years

proxy2_totalCreditTrading.interpretation: high annual correlation exists, but 40% of year-to-year direction changes disagree in this tiny sample and the level relation may be driven partly by shared secular decline

creditTrading.officialEvidence: TWSE reports domestic individuals exceed 98% of margin trading participants at end-July 2026 while credit trading is about 6.09% of overall market trading value in 2026 Jan-Jul
creditTrading.conclusion: high identity purity does not imply broad coverage of retail trading

intradayOddLot.officialEvidence: TWSE reports domestic individuals are 82.5% of intraday odd-lot trading value for 2020-10-26 through 2024-10-30, while all odd-lot trading is about 0.91% of centralized-market trading value in that period
intradayOddLot.conclusion: odd-lot is a strong retail-heavy channel but a poor stand-alone proxy for total retail participation

falsification: High investor-identity purity is not the same as high coverage of the retail universe.
A high level correlation over six annual points does not validate causal equivalence or stock-level use.
Shared secular decline can inflate level correlation; first-difference correlation is lower and direction disagreements occur.
Margin purchasing and total credit trading have different mechanics and should not be collapsed into one retail proxy.
Odd-lot statistics describe a special trading channel and cannot be generalized to all retail trading.
Aggregate market participation cannot be backfilled into stock-date retail direction.
No return, MFE, MAE or stock-selection outcomes are used in this stage.

proxyEvaluationFramework.rule: A proxy may be high-purity but low-coverage, or broad-coverage but identity-weak. No single proxy may be promoted to direct retail flow without passing all relevant dimensions.

result.maturityDecision: D06-19 stays L2/40; this stage strengthens falsification and proxy-validation design but does not solve stock-date PIT source access.

exactNext: Extend aggregate comparison to additional annual/monthly finalized TWSE investor-share publications where common-frequency proxy history is available.
If day-trading investor-class aggregate data become directly available, evaluate identity purity and coverage separately before correlation.
Do not use returns or stock-level outcomes until the stock-date investor-class source contract is authorized and PIT-safe.
Special TWSE investor-type data pursuit still requires owner authorization before contact/request/purchase.
